clarifications_needed: Geography: BN service territory mapped from handbook README as FL, AZ, CA (NorCal only — SoCal excluded per handbook), UT, CO, WA, NC, NJ, NY, CT, PA, VA, MD, DC — confirm this region list and whether the SoCal exclusion should be encoded as a zip-band exclusion or handled in list-building filters

size_band employee counts are proxied from room counts (200-key boutique ≈ 100–350 employees; 150–500-key franchised resort ≈ 150–600 employees) — proxy not confirmed by BN engagement data; operator redline against first-season discovery calls
revenue bands are estimated from ADR bands in the playbook ($250–600 ADR, ~$5M–$75M gross revenue depending on occupancy and room count) and are unvalidated by BN engagement data

seed_accounts are drawn from playbook exemplars and publicly known properties in named competitive markets (Park City, Scottsdale, Naples, Miami, Aspen, Vail); some exemplars (Hotel del Coronado, Callaway) sit outside BN territory and are look-alike anchors only; verify Ambius is not an active incumbent before outreach

intent_signals: Press release or CVB announcement of a named seasonal program (e.g., 'Christmas at [Property]') within the past 6 months — signals existing programming muscle and YoY refresh candidacy
New GM appointment within the past 6–12 months — GM audit cycles run months 3–9 of tenure; outbound landing in that window fits the audit cadence
Capital renovation, F&B concept launch, pool-deck or lobby-refresh announcement within the past 6–18 months — signals property in a capital-spending window
STR/RevPAR data showing the property under-indexing the comp set on ADR — larger upside case for rate-premium programming
Property publicly discussing OTA commission pressure, direct-channel initiatives, or launching a package-only stay program
Peak-date or destination-weekend reservation windows published (Fri/Sat-only windows, compression-date pricing structures)
Job posting for Director of Revenue or Revenue Manager — signals property scaling revenue-management sophistication
exclusions: Corporate-managed enterprise chain flagships (Marriott Marquis, Waldorf Astoria, Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, Gaylord full-scale properties) — multi-year RFP procurement, brand-standard-constrained programming authority
Properties under 80 keys without luxury ADR positioning — below the room-count threshold where ADR-lift math produces program ROI
Properties with AV integrator already embedded in an active experiential-tech engagement (AVI-SPL XTG, Diversified)
Properties where Ambius holds an active plant-and-amenity contract that includes holiday decor (incumbent-lock pattern; qualify during discovery)

intent_signals: Franchised property (not corporate-managed) confirmed via franchise disclosure or operator registry — franchisees retain local vendor discretion below brand-standard thresholds
Property GM actively engaged on LinkedIn during Q1–Q2 planning season discussing guest experience initiatives or seasonal programming
Property posting a Director of Marketing or Guest Experience role — signals programming investment cycle underway
Renovation or repositioning announcement within the past 12 months — co-invested seasonal program fits the property's upgrade narrative
STR data showing the property trailing its brand-tier comp set in the local market on ADR
Property listed on AAHOA member directory or conference attendee list — owner-operator overlap signals local vendor authority
Package-marketing launch (stay-and-experience bundles) in the past 6 months
exclusions: Corporate-managed chain properties requiring HSM (Hilton Supply Management) or Avendra procurement approval before property can engage
Properties under 150 keys in secondary markets without event or F&B programming spend
Newly opened properties in first 12 months of operation — pre-stabilized RevPAR displaces programming investment
